method: Full original RGBA; body then head; native canvas128x128 origin16,64; no centering, resizing per frame, semantic shadow removal or hidden-joint estimation. Source display upscales are nearest-neighbor only.

timing.clock_scope: Only current/reference cadence. Artwork metadata cannot verify original EXE clock entry, reset, first displayed tick or movement speed.

uncertainty: Pixel extents/hash/offset are exact decoded data. Proxy plus/minus ranges are manual interpretation tolerances in original 1x pixels, not statistical confidence intervals or recovered skeletal positions.

view_contract.facing: SW toward screen lower-left; elevated front-three-quarter view, not full S/front, W/profile, SE/mirror or rear
view_contract.upper_body: Near screen-right sleeve/arm has broader and longer exposed outline; screen-left sleeve compressed/partly occluded. Clothing edge is not a shoulder joint.
view_contract.head: Original head layer faces screen-left/down; preserve small phase differences. Do not inherit old brown hairstyle/color; modern short black hair identity supplies appearance.
view_contract.feet: Two observed endpoints are staggered upper-left and lower, approximately canvas(32,78) and(38,88), each ±1px; preserve projected depth separation rather than leveling soles. Physical planted contact and support-side identity are not established.
view_contract.hands: Near screen-right hand terminal visible. Screen-left warm patch is ambiguous beside gold garment trim; do not demand an independently exposed second hand or invent fingers.
view_contract.identity: Current Earth SE/S: adult East Asian man, short black hair, fitted black technical cloth, compact silver/graphite plates, two muted red shoulder caps, small upper side pieces, separate knee/shin, gloves/boots. No weapon/backpack/cape, new emblem, cyan core or old robe bands.
view_contract.lighting: Warm screen-upper-left key remains fixed; never flip baked highlights.
